notes.title: 🐣 Update v14932: Easter DLC, Balance Tweaks & More! 🐀⚔️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/6814f8b735e4ba10925a744f813d893602f7ed09.png[/img]

[h1]Happy Easter Ratdom,[/h1]

Spring has sprung in the Northern Wastes, and we’re celebrating with a [b]25% off sale[/b] on Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter! Now’s the perfect time to dive into our latest update, brimming with Easter-themed goodies, balance tweaks, and polish to make your adventure sharper than a rat’s claw. Hop into Update v14932 and discover what’s new!

Happy egg-hunting,
United Label & Odd Bug Studio


[h2]Patch Notes - Update V14932:[/h2]
[h3]New Easter DLC[/h3]
Get ready to crack some eggs with these festive additions: 
[list]
[*] A brittle Easter Eggshell Armour Set – this delicate gear offers minimal protection, daring bold rats to rely on skill alone. Think you’ve got what it takes to conquer the entire game wearing this and this alone?  
[*] A One-Handed Easter Sword, brimming with seasonal spirit, for slicing foes with festive flair.  
[*] Exclusive upgrade paths for both the armour and sword.
[/list]
[h3]Boss Fight Tuning[/h3]
Based on player feedback, we’ve rebalanced these encounters for a smoother experience:  
[list]
[*] Scorchlin Rider – now easier to ease new players into the adventure
[*] Baron Frostavik – fine-tuned for a fairer fight
[*] Elder WereOwl – adjusted for better balance
[*] WereOwl (side quest variant) – tweaked to match the main quest’s flow
[/list]
[h3]Crafting Adjustment[/h3]
[list]
[*] Refined the crafting requirements for WereOwl Bows – now requiring beaks and feathers
[/list]
[h3]In-game Credits Adjustment:  [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added missing names to give proper shout-outs to our team.  
[*] Enhanced image quality for sharper, clearer visuals – give ‘em a look!
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in an execution animation during the combat tutorial, including Arlo’s issue with Backstabber Pups on the left edge of the arena.

notes.title: Update: 'Happy Valentails' - New DLC, Intel GPU Fix, Subtitle Adjustment & More
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/27d57e73201834bc5d90b28171dfc25fe7e0c1c6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Happy Valentails, Ratdom! ❤️🐀[/h3]
Love is in the air... and so are arrows! 💘 Whether you're braving the Northern Wastes solo or battling side-by-side with your most loyal rat companion, we’ve got a little something to help you wear your heart on your sleeve, literally!

[h3]Valentine's Day Update🏹[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Valentine's Day DLC[/b] – Dress to impress with the Cupid-themed armour set featuring a new Helmet, Pauldron, winged Cuirass, and Bow, plus full upgrade trees!
[/list][b]How to Unlock:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Game:[/b] Some items and blueprints are earned after completing the intro quest (automatically added to Inventory).
[*] [b]Existing Saves:[/b] If you've already passed the intro, the items will be automatically added to Arlo's Inventory.
[/list][h3]Integrated Intel GPU Update[/h3]
We've resolved launch crashes for systems using integrated Intel GPUs through the addition of a new Texture Quality setting from within the main menu. However, we’re also aware of Fast Travel crashes that can occur after long play sessions on those systems. Such crashes don’t corrupt saves or block progress, and are the result of a limitation of the hardware. 

[h2]Patch Notes [/h2]

[h3]New Features & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Texture Quality setting[/b] – Intel GPU users can now launch the game using the Low setting.
[*] [b]Subtitle Size setting[/b] – Adjust text size to make sure every rat gets the perfect reading experience.
[*] [b]Steam Cloud Save Support [/b]– Transfer saves seamlessly between Windows and MacOS.
[/list][h3]Fixes & Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed [/b]controller issues on MacOS (M1 and above).
[*] [b]Fixed [/b]the 'Load Game' menu not opening if a save file was corrupted.
[*] [b]Fixed [/b]a game freeze caused by Mudwyrms using the Dig circle marker attack simultaneously.
[*] [b]Fixed [/b]WereOwl Pauldron items displaying awkwardly while sprinting.
[*] [b]Adjusted[/b] crafting requirements for:
[/list]- Fire Wyrm Sting (One-Handed Spear)
- Electric Slash (One-Handed Axe)
- TH Ice Katana (Two-Handed Sword)
- TH Long Winter Slammer (Two-Handed Axe)

Stay sharp, stay fierce, and spread the love (or the carnage)! 💕⚔️

United Label & Odd Bug Studio

notes.title: Update: V 1.14555 Sky Scorcher Vangor Fix, Fixed Secret Tomb, And More...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/94ff4205c8cd7d4bb4a4fa6d96ee939caf5cd60c.jpg[/img]
[h3]Hey Ratdom,[/h3] 

We’ve been hard at work squashing grub bugs and making improvements to ensure your journey through the Northern Wastes is as smooth (and brutal) as ever!

Just a quick update: We’re actively investigating the crashing issue on Intel GPUs and testing a fix. We’ll keep you posted as soon as we have more information to share.

P.S. Today is the last chance to grab Tails of Iron 2 at its celebratory 20% launch discount, don’t miss out!

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where The Undead Sky Scorcher Vangor could get stuck mid-air during the fight in Mount Cauldron.
[*] Fixed The Outskirts Tomb opening too early after performing specific steps.
[*] Fixed Mole Parts not being available for purchase in the Crimson Keep if the shop was upgraded beyond Level 1.
[*] Fixed Slither Scale Hatchlings not dropping loot as intended.
[*] Fixed Shrimp Parts being incorrectly required for crafting the Slither Scale Tier 3 Gun.
[*] Fixed an issue where Elementas cooldowns were not resetting upon death.
[/list]
If you're having a blast with the game, we’d love to hear your thoughts! Dropping a Steam review means the world to us and helps shape the future of Tails of Iron 2.

We're committed to bringing even more fixes and improvements, so stay tuned!

Thanks for your incredible support,

Today, we’re rolling out a hotfix that addresses the following issues:

[list]

[/list]
If you’re enjoying the game, we’d love to hear from you! Leaving a Steam review helps us out immensely and lets us know what you think.

We’ll keep working on more fixes and improvements, so stay tuned!

Thanks again for your support,

notes.title: Sharpen Your Axe! Brutal Gamescom Trailer Unveils Tails of Iron 2 Release Date!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/f8e5e1a238bb830aa5e3f1d7c22a0e2dd9a837a5.png[/img]
[h3]Hear Ye, Ratkind![/h3]

A new saga is about to begin… We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] is officially launching in February 2025! Get ready to take up the mantle of Arlo, son of the Warden of the North, pick up a sharpened battle axe (or broadsword or spear… there are plenty of weapons of choice!) and defend your homeland after the devastating attack by the Dark Wings - an ancient evil from the frozen wastelands beyond.

In our brand new trailer, we’ve unveiled fresh gameplay footage showcasing Arlo’s brutal journey of survival and revenge. The Viking-esque aesthetic of this new story is emphasized by Fever Ray’s haunting 2008 track, ‘If I Had a Heart’ – we think it’s a fitting accompaniment to the harsh and unforgiving world Arlo must navigate through in the game.

[previewyoutube=Sg5FBayiuWc;full][/previewyoutube]
The new release date ensures we can provide the very best experience possible, and we absolutely cannot wait to reveal what’s in store for would-be vikings come early 2025. 

[h3]Your Feedback & Next steps[/h3]

We were truly humbled to see so many of you dive into the demo during June’s Steam Next Fest. Your enthusiasm and support means everything to us, and we’ve been listening closely to your feedback. Many of you enjoyed the new gameplay mechanics we introduced, but there was one point that needed a little attention – the weapon sharpening mechanic.

Thanks to your invaluable feedback, we’re making the following adjustments to the game at launch:

[list]
[*] Whetstones will now act more like weapon buffs; when used, they will increase the weapon's damage output for a limited time, similar to the poison mechanic in the original [i]Tails of Iron[/i].
[*] Weapons will no longer dull, resulting in bounce back and the inability to hit enemies. This has been entirely removed.
[*] Managing the ‘health’ of the whetstone is no longer a requirement.
[*] Whetstones are now purchasable at the shop and can also be found in the world and as an enemy drop.
[/list]
We believe these changes will make for a more fluid and enjoyable experience, and we’re incredibly grateful for your input, which has been essential in refining the game. With these improvements, we’re looking forward to bringing you an adventure truly worthy of the Viking sagas of old!
